text: Terafab is moving fast — quoting @tesla: Tesla's chip effort is moving at Tesla speed, not semiconductor speed. Elon says TeraFab is going well, and @FutureAZA watched the related Fab Lab at Giga Texas go from bare ground to steel in days. Brian saw the site still lit and dusty at midnight, with work continuing
zh: 马斯克：TeraFab 推进很快 — 引用：特斯拉芯片产线以特斯拉速度而非半导体行业速度推进，TeraFab 进展顺利；得州超级工厂相关晶圆厂从空地到钢结构仅用数日，午夜仍在施工

text: Tesla will be winding down production of the Cybertruck at Gigafactory Texas around the middle of next year to make room for increased Cybercab production
zh: 马斯克：特斯拉将于明年年中前后在得州超级工厂逐步停产Cybertruck，以便腾出产能扩大Cybercab生产

text: Not bad — quoting @unknown: 🚨 Tesla is outselling the next twelve EV makers combined in California… $TSLA @elonmusk
zh: 马斯克：「还不错」——转引：特斯拉在加州销量超过其后十二家电动车企销量之和

text: 🇰🇷 Tesla Korea 🇰🇷 — quoting @unknown: BREAKING: Tesla beats Mercedes-Benz and BMW to stay No. 1 in South Korea’s imported car market for the 9th straight month. October registrations surged 110.7% year over year to 9,165. Model Y Premium led all imports.
zh: 马斯克：特斯拉韩国——转引：特斯拉连续第9个月蝉联韩国进口车销量第一，10月注册量同比大增110.7%至9165辆，Model Y Premium居进口车榜首

text: SIGNED: Designating the Oval Office as a National Monument, protecting the historic office for good.
zh: 白宫：签署行政令，将椭圆形办公室定为国家纪念地，永久保护这一历史办公场所。

text: “The Stock Market suffered one of the Worst Days in History based on the results of the Election. Such a sad thing to watch! It took so much work to get us to a level that no one has ever seen before, and then this. Your 401(k)s have, therefore, dropped. Remember, it wasn’t
zh: 白宫：称大选结果后股市遭遇史上最差交易日之一，401(k)随之下跌

text:
Flying high!

Today, our X-59 quiet supersonic X-59 aircraft traveled from Birmingham, Alabama, to Daytona Beach, Florida. The aircraft aims to fly faster than sound with just a gentle thump rather than a sonic boom — helping usher in a new era of faster air travel.
zh: NASA：X-59安静超音速试验机从阿拉巴马飞往代托纳比奇，目标以轻响而非音爆实现超音速飞行

text: Interesting — quoting @: The governor-elect of Texas, Gina Hinojosa, has explicitly said that all currently permitted datacenters in Texas will be allowed to finish construction. This essentially covers all of the 2027 and likely well into 2028.
zh: 马斯克：认为有意思——得州候任州长称已获批数据中心可完工，约覆盖2027至2028年建设

text: Did you receive a text message or email from the Federal Reserve claiming that there is suspicious activity on your bank account? Scammers use phony alerts and other tactics to steal your personal financial information. For more information about how to protect you, your family,
zh: 美联储：提醒勿信声称账户异常的伪冒美联储短信或邮件，谨防骗取个人信息

text:
New Medicare policies will lower costs by more than $1 BILLION for seniors next year.

Effective policy to help the American people where they need it most.
zh: 白宫：新医保政策明年将为老年人节省超10亿美元费用

text: Banks arguably has the best vision for the future — quoting @: In Ian Banks' Culture books, the Culture is a civilization of compute abundance. Each General System Vehicle is a loose sandbox environment practicing different ideologies, and citizens freely move between ships to experience different lifestyles.
zh: 马斯克：称Banks对未来愿景Arguably最好——算力充裕文明下公民可在不同意识形态环境间自由迁徙

text:
Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber: a major advance in security research that pairs stronger capabilities with better model alignment.

The model powered the Linux kernel research we announced yesterday, and security teams at companies like Mozilla, Palo Alto Networks, Calif, and
zh: OpenAI：发布GPT-6 Cyber，强化安全研究能力与模型对齐，已用于Linux内核研究并为Mozilla等安全团队所用

text:
"Now we must use the courage we brought to Oleshky to find common ground through a shared concern for the suffering of innocent people."

@FLOTUS Melania Trump unites Russia and Ukraine following the historic ceasefire that she brokered in Oleshky.
zh: 白宫：第一夫人梅拉尼娅推动俄乌在Oleshky停火后，呼吁以共同关切无辜者苦难寻找共识

text: Starlink saves lives — quoting @: BREAKING: Starlink just brought high-speed internet to a clinic serving 10 remote islands in Indonesia. Pangkep's local government equipped Sailus Health Center with Starlink, helping staff send patient referrals online and coordinate care across the islands.
zh: 马斯克：Starlink拯救生命——印尼偏远岛屿诊所已用其实现转诊与跨岛协作

text: True — quoting @: Starlink is becoming a GAME CHANGER for airlines, driving higher customer satisfaction, stronger loyalty and even influencing which airline passengers choose to fly with
zh: 马斯克：称星链正改变航空业，提升满意度与忠诚度并影响乘客选航

text:
Closing in on Didymos.

Our planetary defence mission Hera has captured its first close-up of the binary asteroid system, 60 km away, as it prepares to investigate the aftermath of DART’s historic impact with Dimorphos.

Detailed images of both asteroids are coming on 25
zh: ESA：行星防御任务Hera首次近距拍摄双小行星Didymos系统（约60公里），将查DART撞击Dimorphos后的结果

text: LIVE: Watch as @astro_anil and Joshua Kutryk of @csa_asc install the final roll-out solar array on the @space_station during a spacewalk that will last about seven hours. The solar arrays will boost power to the orbital lab.
zh: NASA：宇航员正进行约7小时舱外活动，安装空间站最后一块展开式太阳能电池阵以提升供电

text: Mars may not be geologically dead after all. Our ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter has detected hydrogen chloride above volcanic fissures in the Alba Mons region, which scientists suggest could be linked to dormant volcanic activity beneath the surface.
zh: 欧洲航天局：ExoMars 痕量气体轨道器在火星阿尔巴山火山裂隙上方探测到氯化氢，科学家认为可能与地下休眠火山活动有关，火星或许并非地质上已死。

text: Images, upgraded—introducing ChatGPT Images 2.6. Now with GIFs and reference images. Plus, two new models are coming to the API with 50% faster image generation.
zh: OpenAI：推出 ChatGPT Images 2.6，支持 GIF 与参考图；API 还将上线两款新模型，图像生成提速约 50%。

text: Our security researchers built an autonomous cyber vulnerability discovery, exploitation, and patching pipeline. In a single run with an upcoming cyber model, it validated and generated patches for 948 local privilege escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel
zh: OpenAI：安全团队用即将推出的网络安全模型，单次跑通发现—利用—修补流水线，为 Linux 内核 948 个本地提权漏洞验证并生成补丁。

text: We're sharing how our biology research team worked with Claude to map the first 3D structure of a vault particle from bacterial life.
zh: Anthropic：生物学团队借助 Claude，首次解析出细菌生命中 vault 粒子的三维结构。

text: Today, as part of Operation Economic Outcast, Treasury targeted the vast criminal network of India-based Suniel Kumar Sharma and his spouse, Jaspreet Preeti Shahid, who have supported Iran's shadow fleet through a web maritime fraud.
zh: 美国财政部：「经济放逐」行动制裁印度籍 Sharma 夫妇为伊朗影子船队提供假旗等海事欺诈的犯罪网络。

text: The Donroe Doctrine is taking back the Western Hemisphere. "President Trump's 'Donroe Doctrine' has solidified the US grip over almost two-thirds of the Western Hemisphere, cutting deals with pro-America governments, targeting drug cartels, and booting Chinese influence"
zh: 白宫：特朗普「Donroe Doctrine」巩固美对西半球近三分之二的掌控，签亲美协议、打毒卡特尔、排挤中国影响。

text: Join us for @astro_anil and @astro_kutryk's next spacewalk! Tune in here on Nov. 5 at 8:30am ET (1330 UTC) to watch the astronauts install and deploy the second of two new solar arrays on the @Space_Station.
zh: NASA：11月5日美东8:30（UTC 13:30）直播舱外活动，宇航员将安装并展开空间站第二块新太阳能电池板。

text: At last there will be one network with good signal everywhere! — quoting @Starlink: Starlink Mobile is building the first fully-integrated US nationwide satellite and terrestrial network; 5G base stations will leverage Qualcomm chips, starting in 2027
zh: 马斯克：终于会有一张处处信号都好的网络——转评 Starlink Mobile：将建美国首个卫星+地面全国网，5G基站用高通芯片，2027年起部署。

text: Free new dish for all early Starlink customers — quoting: Eligible early customers still on first-generation kits can receive a new Standard kit at no cost
zh: 马斯克：早期星链用户可免费换新天线——转评：仍用首代套件的早期用户可免费获标准套件。

text: Qualcomm's technology is excellent — quoting @Qualcomm: SpaceX selected Qualcomm Dragonwing to accelerate Starlink Mobile's nationwide terrestrial 5G network and a path to AI-native 6G
zh: 马斯克：高通技术很出色——转评高通：SpaceX 选用 Dragonwing 加速 Starlink Mobile 全国地面 5G，并迈向 AI 原生 6G。
